name: Spider-Man Triple
look: A redrawn take on the 1960s cartoon pointing scene with three Spider-Men pointing at one another. Their suits resemble the Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield and Tom Holland film versions, standing between a white van with an open door and wooden crates by a red wall.
use: Three people or things that are basically the same accuse or recognize one another. Each Spider-Man gets a label, often three versions of the same thing or three groups guilty of the same habit.
